portal.headline: The *Laboratory Space* for Cloud Computing and the Internet of Things
lead: Interactive laboratory manuals and the course knowledge base, in one place. Work through each laboratory’s checkpoints in the browser, record your measurements as you take them, and keep your downloaded progress file as the record of your work.
Submissions and grades remain in Avenue to Learn; nothing you enter here leaves your browser.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Database
knowledge.description: Reusable student support organized by concept family: LabVIEW, circuits, measurement, Arduino, simulation, and engineering practice. Every topic offers a short explanation, a practical check, and a relevant lab connection, so students can search or filter concepts and return straight to the lab workflow.
